items.problem: `auth.guestSweepIntervalMs` has schema minimum 0, but `server-time.schedule_job` rejects a period below 1 (server/core/server-time/scheduler.ts:164, skills/server-core/modules/server-time.md:90). Input: `auth.guestSweepIntervalMs` 0 with a non-null `auth.inactiveGuestDeleteAfterMs` passes the schema, server/core/auth/index.ts:150 registers job `auth_guest_sweep` with period 0, and the server does not start. The range gave `routing.storageSweepIntervalMs` minimum 1 for this same problem and did not change this key. Read from the code, not run

`auth.socialVerifyTimeoutMs` has schema `minimum` 0 (settings/core-settings.schema.json:186), and `timed` passes the value to `server-time.network_time_limit`, which throws `RangeError` when ms is below 1 (server/core/server-time/network_time_limit.ts:9). With value 0, a social `Login`, `LinkAccount` and the `google` method of `POST /account/deletion` reach a throw instead of the rejection, time limit exceeded or communication failure that the spec sets. The server still starts with this value, so server/core/routing/tests/settings-minimum.test.ts does not catch it. It existed before the range, and the range raised only period keys to 1. The spec side is D7 of records/review-debt/spec-auth.json
